name: Overlays
description: Surfaces that sit above the scene. Crystal supplies the material and the separation; the product supplies real modality, focus containment and focus return.

components.name: Dialog
components.anatomy: A Mirage scrim, a Haze decision surface, a title, body and named actions.
components.material: Mirage scrim; 80% feathered Haze surface above it
components.geometry: Content radius; 12px minimum from content to the feathered edge
components.semantics: Real modal semantics with a named dialog, focus containment, Escape, and focus return to the trigger
components.crystal: Scrim, surface, entrance and exit motion, elevation
components.product: Modality, focus management, the decision itself and its consequences

components.name: Drawer
components.anatomy: An edge-anchored panel over a Mirage scrim, with a label and a close control.
components.material: Mirage scrim, Frost or Resin panel by depth
components.geometry: Panel radius on the inner edges only
components.semantics: Dialog semantics when modal; a complementary region when not. Modality must be real, not implied.
components.crystal: Panel material, edge geometry, entrance direction

components.name: Menu
components.anatomy: A Resin popover of actions, with optional groups, separators and checkable items.
components.geometry: Content radius; rows reserve leading room for the selection rail on every row
components.semantics: role=menu with full keyboard navigation, type-ahead and Escape; checkable items use aria-checked
components.crystal: Surface, row treatment, rail placement, separators
components.product: The menu implementation, actions and dismissal

components.name: Context menu
components.anatomy: Menu anatomy opened at a pointer position or from a keyboard context key.
components.geometry: Repositions to stay within the viewport
components.semantics: Must be reachable by keyboard, not pointer-only; never the sole route to an action
components.product: The actions and the keyboard route

components.name: Popover
components.anatomy: An anchored Resin surface holding arbitrary content, with optional arrow.
components.geometry: Content radius; flips and shifts to stay in view
components.semantics: The trigger carries aria-expanded and aria-controls; focus moves in for interactive content

components.name: Hover card
components.anatomy: A popover that opens on hover or focus after a delay, showing preview content.
components.semantics: Must also open on keyboard focus; never contains the only route to an action

components.name: Tooltip
components.anatomy: Short supplemental text on a small Resin surface, anchored to its trigger.
components.semantics: Never the sole accessible name. Opens on focus as well as hover, dismisses on Escape, and stays while hovered.
components.product: Content and whether a tooltip is the right disclosure at all

components.name: Scrim
components.anatomy: The Mirage layer separating an overlay from the scene beneath it.
components.material: Mirage: chromatic diffusion of the real scene beneath
components.geometry: Full viewport, or region-scoped for a local overlay
components.semantics: Content beneath is inert; the scrim is not a focus target; clicking it dismisses only when dismissal is safe
components.crystal: The complete Mirage recipe and its reduced-transparency fallback
components.product: Inertness, dismissal policy and stack order

components.name: Portal
components.anatomy: A mechanism for rendering an overlay outside its layout parent.
components.semantics: Portalled content must preserve the logical focus and reading order of its trigger

components.name: Floating window
components.anatomy: A draggable, resizable panel that stays within the viewport.
components.geometry: Panel radius; the resize handle reaches 44px.
components.semantics: role="dialog" when modal-like; focus is trapped only when it is modal.
components.crystal: Material, elevation, drag and resize motion
